item.title: Allegations Resurface That Supervisor Sherrill Got Appointed In Backroom Deal to Benefit London Breed
item.description: Some SF City Hall gossip is rearing its head again alleging that former SF Mayor London Breed appointed Supervisor Stephen Sherrill in order to score a job with big-bucks benefactor Michael Bloomberg.

item.title: Sam Altman Admits Friday Pentagon Deal Was Rushed, Adds More Safeguards to Contract
item.description: Continuing the tradition of tech CEOs appearing to be transparent performing their mea culpas on social media, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman took to Xitter Monday to say a few things about that rushed Friday deal with the Pentagon, following the collapse of a deal with Anthropic.

item.title: The Zuckerberg-Chans Just Broke a Miami Home Price Record With Mansion Purchase on Indian Creek
item.description: We heard a few weeks ago that Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan were, for reasons we can only guess, seeking out a new home in Miami, and the deal reportedly closed on Monday.

item.title: Mayor Lurie Says He’s Laying Off 500 SF City Hall Employees, Which Will Not Endear Him to the Labor Unions
item.description: Daniel Lurie says that at least 500 City Hall jobs are on the chopping block, a move he avoided last year through accounting tricks, and Lurie may not exactly be Mr. Popular anymore once that axe comes down.

item.title: Charli xcx, RÜFÜS DU SOL, The xx, and the Strokes to Headline Outside Lands 2026
item.description: The Outside Lands lineup this year looks a lot like the Portola Fest lineup of the last couple of years, with acts like Charli xcx and RÜFÜS DU SOL topping the bill.

item.title: Weekly ‘Overpass Visibility Dance Party’ Lights Up Berkeley Freeway Every Friday Night
item.description: The Friday night dance party takes place on an I-80 overpass in Berkeley, a daytime protest hotspot, transforming the bridge into a glowing display of support for the Bay Area community and those protecting democracy, while urging an estimated 12,000 cars per hour to ‘honk’ in solidarity.

item.title: Humboldt County Might See Its First Condor Chick Hatched In the Wild In a Century
item.description: A pair of California condors who were part of a group released into the wild several years ago appear to be nesting in a redwood tree in remote Humboldt County, and tending to an egg.

item.title: Lowell High School Teacher on Leave After Giving Students Quizzes Demeaning Girls, ‘Fat Kids’
item.description: A math teacher who’s been at SF’s top public high school for 20 years went on leave after giving students quizzes that demeaned girls and “fat kids,” and some parents are unhappy he posted “Grades vs. Dignity” videos on YouTube of students dancing in exchange for extra credit.

item.title: Trump’s Garish Trump Force One Airplane Popped Into SFO Monday for Some Reason
item.description: President Trump was not on his ridiculously self-named Trump Force One airplane when it blew through SFO on Monday, but maybe one of his idiot sons had crypto business in town or something, as the plane was spotted here.

item.title: Day Around the Bay: State’s Top Democrat Tells Too-Large Plethora of Governor Candidates to Drop Out of Race
item.description: The Bay Area got more transit money for the upcoming World Cup; the Giants are bringing back free opera in the ballpark; and the state Democratic Party chair has had it with these way too many Democrats running for governor.
